item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-129289 - PHP PHP Inconsistent Interpretation of HTTP Requests
item.description:
PHP-FPM request smuggling through an unread HTTP request body. PHP does not discard the unread part of an HTTP request body at request shutdown when the application has opened php://input without reading it to the end. When the front end reuses backend connections, which is not the default in nginx or Apache (for example nginx with fastcgi_keep_conn on, or Apache mod_proxy_fcgi with enablereuse=on), PHP-FPM can parse the leftover bytes as a new FastCGI request. An unauthenticated remote attacker can use a single crafted multipart/form-data request to forge a backend request with chosen parameters such as SCRIPT_FILENAME, REMOTE_ADDR and PHP_ADMIN_VALUE, which can lead to execution of attacker-controlled PHP code. With LSAPI, subsequent requests on the connection can be disrupted. This issue affects PHP versions before 8.2.36, 8.3.* before 8.3.37, 8.4.* before 8.4.28 and 8.5.* before 8.5.13.

Vendor: PHP
Product: PHP

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://api.vulncheck.com/v3/index/vulncheck-canaries?cve=CVE-2026-129289&date=2026-11-21

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2019-17382 - Zabbix zabbix Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key
item.description:
An issue was discovered in zabbix.php?action=dashboard.view&dashboardid=1 in Zabbix through 4.4. An attacker can bypass the login page and access the dashboard page, and then create a Dashboard, Report, Screen, or Map without any Username/Password (i.e., anonymously). All created elements (Dashboard/Report/Screen/Map) are accessible by other users and by an admin.

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-87741 - convertplug convertplus Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command
item.description:
The ConvertPlus plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Deserialization of Untrusted Data in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.3 via the style parameter of the cp_display_preview_modal AJAX action. The vulnerability exists because the action's nonce guard is gated behind an isset() check and fails open when the cp_admin_page_nonce parameter is omitted entirely, no capability check is performed on the callback, and sanitize_text_field() — applied to the $style value before it is concatenated directly into a shortcode string evaluated by do_shortcode() — does not strip shortcode delimiters, allowing an attacker to inject a second, fully attacker-controlled [smile_modal] invocation that causes smile_modal_popup() to pass attacker-supplied base64-decoded bytes to maybe_unserialize() with no allowed_classes restriction. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present.

Vendor: Brainstorm Force
Product: ConvertPlus

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://patchstack.com/database/wordpress/plugin/convertplug/vulnerability/wordpress-convertplus-plugin-3-6-3-authenticated-subscriber-php-object-injection-vulnerability

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-127027 - analogic poste.io Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command
item.description:
Poste.io is vulnerable to remote code execution in DMARC report processing. Email sent to dmarc-reports@ is saved without sender verification. Script that runs as root unpacks the attachments using unsafe shell commands, allowing command injection through crafted attachments (e.g. file names or archive contents). A remote unauthenticated attacker who can send an email to the server's port 25 can execute arbitrary commands as root within the Poste.io container. This issue was fixed in version 2.5.22.

Vendor: Analogic
Product: Poste.io

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-127027

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-56681 - Reliance on Untrusted Inputs in a Security Decision
item.description:
9Router is an AI router & token saver. Prior to 0.5.6, 9Router deployments that allow requests to reach Next.js without the sanitizing custom-server.js wrapper trust the client-supplied X-9r-Real-Ip header in src/dashboardGuard.js when isLocalRequest decides whether canAccessPublicLlmApi may skip API-key validation for /api/v1/* routes. A remote unauthenticated attacker can set X-9r-Real-Ip to 127.0.0.1 and be classified as a local client, including on the verified GET /api/v1/models route. This permits unauthorized use of the instance owner's configured LLM providers, consumption of paid credits, and enumeration of configured providers and models. This issue is fixed in version 0.5.6.

Vendor: decolua
Product: 9Router

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://api.vulncheck.com/v3/index/vulncheck-canaries?cve=CVE-2026-56681&date=2026-11-20

item.title: [vulncheck] CVE-2026-79748 - mcphubx mcphub Missing Authorization
item.description:
MCPHub is a unified hub for centrally managing and dynamically orchestrating multiple MCP servers/APIs into separate endpoints with flexible routing strategies. Prior to version 0.12.15, the POST /api/servers and PUT /api/servers/:name endpoints in MCPHub create/update MCP server configurations and then immediately spawn the configured stdio process via child_process.spawn. Authentication is required, but there is no authorization check restricting these endpoints to admins, and there is no allowlist/sanitization on the command and args fields. As a result, any authenticated non-admin user can submit a server configuration with command:"/bin/sh" (or any other binary) and arbitrary args, causing MCPHub to execute the attacker-controlled process as the MCPHub server's OS user (commonly root in the published Docker image and in npx/systemd deployments). This issue has been patched in version 0.12.15.

Vendor: mcphubx
Product: mcphub

VulnCheck Reported Exploitation Citations:
  • https://api.vulncheck.com/v3/index/vulncheck-canaries?cve=CVE-2026-79748&date=2026-11-20
